|lore=Imperial officers are fiercely competitive, especially on the ''Executor''. Lord Vader’s flagship is a place where devious political calculation prospers. The naive are doomed to failure.
|game_text=Deploy on your captain or commander. This character is now considered to be an admiral and a leader. Demotion may not be played on Imperials. Once per game, you may ▲ one card with ‘Imperial’ in its title. (Immune to Alter.)
|errata_history=Versions of [[Field Promotion (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time]], in date order (3 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): first release sheet “Virtual Set #5” (Players Committee, 30 May 2003; tournament legal 6 June 2003), page 3, slip 37 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20030801181811/http://www.theforce.net/ccg/vcards/SWCCGVirtualSet5.pdf PDF on theforce.net] linked from the [https://web.archive.org/web/20030603182926/http://swccgpc.com:80/interior.htm PC news post of 30 May 2003] (Internet Archive capture of the PDF, 1 August 2003; PDF dated 30–31 May 2003): “Deploy on your captain or commander. This character is now considered to be an admiral and a leader. Demotion may not be played on Imperials. Once per game, you may ▲ one card with ‘Imperial’ in its title. A” The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “5•37” at bottom right and no expansion icon. The revised sheet of 11 June 2003 (PDF dated 11 June 2003; the copy the Players Committee still hosts at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards5.pdf res.starwarsccg.org]) prints the same words on the same old slip ([[:File:OVS5-37-Field_Promotion-original-slip-2003-06-11.png]]).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Field Promotion (V) (Virtual Set 5) (Errata)]]): a post by Kevin Brownell (“CubsFan”), the Committee's Marketing & Player Relations Advocate in the Committee's forum thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (“official rulings and errata issued by the Rules Committee”), 8 March 2006 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20060617231905/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=4438 Internet Archive capture of 17 June 2006]): “The wording of this card is being changed as a clarification and to conform with the original design intent. The change is in italics:” “Deploy on your captain or commander. This character is now considered to be an admiral and a leader. Imperials are immune to Demotion. Once per game, you may take one card with 'Imperial' in its title into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)” The post gives the text only (no slip image). Stats and lore on this page are those of the earlier slip. '''What changed:''' the errata rewrote the text (full text above).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Field Promotion (V) (Virtual Set 5) (Errata 2)]]): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154714/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards5.pdf Internet Archive capture of 24 October 2007], slip 37), in the Committee's Remaster template: “Deploy on your captain or commander. This character is an admiral and a leader. Imperials are immune to Demotion. Once per game, may take a card with “Imperial” in title into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
